name: Blood shield
look: Blood shield from dark cultivation fantasy. Blood rises from a pool under the character's feet and closes into a tall thin dome round them: a bright crimson rim, dark red veins branching across a see-through film, droplets sliding down, a dull red glow inside.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the whole blood dome alone, as it stands fully formed: a bright crimson rim one to two squares thick, dark red veins branching across it from the base upward, the inside of the dome mostly empty so the character shows through; no glow and no droplets
forms: dented inward on its right side where a blow lands, ripple rings round the dent
sagging and melting down, half drained, drips hanging from its lower edge

parts.name: STREAM
parts.text: one stream of blood alone, rising from the ground
forms: a thin stream just rising, a short curl
a thick stream rising tall and curling over at its top
a stream dripping back down into the ground, thinning

parts.name: POOL
parts.text: the flat pool of blood on the ground under the feet, seen from a low angle, a wide thin ellipse with a bright rim

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: round blood droplets of 1 to 3 squares with a light highlight, a splash of droplets flying right, two faint red mist puffs

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the dull red glow of the dome and the pool, the light they give off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow and no droplets

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: droplets, splashes and mist puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft red light round the dome, the pool and the droplets, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: a pool spreads under the feet, six streams rise from its rim and curl up round the character, meet over the head and the film fills the dome from the bottom up
notes: only a small pool under the feet and a few faint specks: no stream yet
the pool at full width, six thin streams just rising at its rim
six streams rising to waist height, curling
the streams tall and curling inward, meeting over the head
the film filling from the bottom up to the chest, veins spreading
the whole dome fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the dome holds; dark veins flow slowly upward through it, droplets slide down its sides, the rim swells and brightens once like a heartbeat; it loops
notes: the dome as MAIN
veins brighter, flowing up, a droplet sliding down the left side
the rim swollen and brighter, a heartbeat
back as MAIN, the droplet lower

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the right side at chest height; the film dents inward there, ripple rings spread from the dent across the dome, droplets splatter out to the right, then the dent springs back
notes: the blow lands: a bright flash on the right side at chest height, the rim bending inward
the dent at its deepest, ripple rings round it, droplets thrown out to the right
the dent springing back, ripples spreading over the dome, droplets falling
the dome bulging slightly outward past its shape, then settling
the dome whole as MAIN, a few droplets on the ground at the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the film loses its shape, sags and melts down into dripping streams that drain into the pool; the pool shrinks and is gone
notes: the dome as MAIN but dimmer, drips forming on its lower edge
the dome sagging, drips hanging long
half drained: only the lower half of the dome, streams running down into the pool
only the pool and a few drips left, about a third of the pixels of the first frame
a few last faint specks over a small dark stain, under 20 pixels

rules: The effect grows from almost nothing: never jump from an empty cell to a half-formed shape.
The dome is see-through: draw its rim and veins solid and leave the inside empty, its red is light, not paint.

Take only the pixel size and the way the glow is made from the second image, not its colours: every colour is a crimson or dark red from the look, the lightest a pale pink highlight; no outline in black, no gradients wider than a few pixels.
